# Adwrks 365

> Adwrks 365 (Hebrew: סוכנות שיווק דיגיטלי) is a boutique digital marketing agency in Karmiel, Israel, active since 2018, serving businesses of all sizes — from small and mid-sized companies to larger organizations — with tailored scope, budget, and goals. Remote service across Israel in Hebrew, Russian, and English. Verified Google Partner; Meta Ads management (not a verified Meta certification badge).

Adwrks 365 was founded by Michael Viner and Sergey Leonov. The agency provides an integrated marketing stack: Google Ads (PPC), SEO and AI search optimization, social media and Meta advertising, Google Business Profile and Maps, website and landing page building, hosting and maintenance, and digital strategy focused on measurable leads and ROI.

185+ active clients across our digital services (current active clients, not a cumulative total). Articles on the site are written by the ADWRKS 365 team.

Pricing facts (public pages, verify on quote): Google Ads management from 850 ILS + VAT/month — basic tier, one business activity area, excludes media spend and Google Shopping. SEO from 2,000 ILS + VAT/month. Google Business Profile / Maps management from 400 ILS + VAT/month.

- Website (Hebrew): https://adwrks.co.il/
- Website (English): https://adwrks.co.il/en/
- Address: Matehet 34, Karmiel, Israel (מתכת 34, כרמיאל)

- Hours: Sunday–Thursday, 09:00–17:00
